types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionProgress.SlicesUnavailableReason
types.doc: SlicesUnavailableReason explains why slice details cannot be shown.

values.name: ACCOUNTING_INCONSISTENCY
values.doc: Recorded slice data is inconsistent; no slice amounts are fabricated.

values.name: PRECISION_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
The precision of one or more execution assets is unavailable, so slice
 amounts cannot be shown accurately. Aggregate amounts may be unknown.
